subject.title: Consider removing Codex from the application's name

question: Given that the reported Spotlight conflict no longer reproduces, should CodexBar retain its established name or should the project sponsor a full product rebrand?
rationale: This choice sets the product identity and determines whether broad compatibility work across app packaging, CLI distribution, updates, configuration, documentation, and integrations is warranted; source inspection cannot safely choose that direction.

options.title: Retain CodexBar
options.body: Keep the current product and distribution names, and close the request if no current Spotlight regression can be demonstrated.

options.title: Sponsor a staged rebrand
options.body: Choose a new name and define a release-owned migration plan that preserves existing bundle, CLI, config, update, and package-manager compatibility where feasible.

recommendation.title: Retain CodexBar
recommendation.body: Keep the current product and distribution names, and close the request if no current Spotlight regression can be demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is actively soliciting naming ideas and owns the release and app-identity configuration.
